input.business_intent: What are the best performing products of last quarter?

args.sql_query:
WITH product_aggregated AS (
  SELECT 
    join_key_product,
    product_name,
    MAX(standard_price) AS standard_price,
    SUM(filter_positive_sales) AS total_units_sold,
    SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue,
    SUM(transaction_count) AS total_transactions,
    MAX(store_count) AS stores_reached,
    ROUND(SUM(total_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(filter_positive_sales), 0), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_unit,
    ROUND(SUM(total_revenue) - (SUM(filter_positive_sales) * MAX(standard_price)), 2) AS estimated_profit,
    ROUND((SUM(total_revenue) - (SUM(filter_positive_sales) * MAX(standard_price))) / NULLIF(SUM(total_revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct
  FROM best_performing_products
  WHERE filter_positive_sales IS NOT NULL AND filter_positive_sales > 0
  GROUP BY join_key_product, product_name
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC) AS units_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY estimated_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
  FROM product_aggregated
)
SELECT 
  revenue_rank,
  join_key_product AS product_id,
  product_name,
  standard_price,
  total_units_sold,
  total_revenue,
  estimated_profit,
  profit_margin_pct,
  total_transactions,
  stores_reached,
  avg_revenue_per_unit,
  units_rank,
  profit_rank
FROM ranked_products
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 15

-- Get top 10 products by revenue for bar chart
WITH product_aggregated AS (
  SELECT 
    product_name,
    SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue,
    SUM(filter_positive_sales) AS total_units_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(total_revenue) - (SUM(filter_positive_sales) * MAX(standard_price)), 2) AS estimated_profit
  FROM best_performing_products
  WHERE filter_positive_sales IS NOT NULL AND filter_positive_sales > 0
  GROUP BY product_name
)
SELECT 
  product_name,
  ROUND(total_revenue, 2) AS revenue,
  total_units_sold AS units_sold,
  estimated_profit AS profit
FROM product_aggregated
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Get overall summary statistics
WITH product_aggregated AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue_all,
    SUM(filter_positive_sales) AS total_units_all,
    COUNT(DISTINCT join_key_product) AS total_products,
    ROUND(AVG(total_revenue), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_product,
    MAX(total_revenue) AS max_product_revenue
  FROM best_performing_products
  WHERE filter_positive_sales IS NOT NULL AND filter_positive_sales > 0
)
SELECT * FROM product_aggregated

-- Create complete dataset for HTML report generation
WITH product_aggregated AS (
  SELECT 
    join_key_product,
    product_name,
    MAX(standard_price) AS standard_price,
    SUM(filter_positive_sales) AS total_units_sold,
    SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue,
    SUM(transaction_count) AS total_transactions,
    MAX(store_count) AS stores_reached,
    ROUND(SUM(total_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(filter_positive_sales), 0), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_unit,
    ROUND(SUM(total_revenue) - (SUM(filter_positive_sales) * MAX(standard_price)), 2) AS estimated_profit,
    ROUND((SUM(total_revenue) - (SUM(filter_positive_sales) * MAX(standard_price))) / NULLIF(SUM(total_revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct
  FROM best_performing_products
  WHERE filter_positive_sales IS NOT NULL AND filter_positive_sales > 0
  GROUP BY join_key_product, product_name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS rank
  FROM product_aggregated
)
SELECT 
  rank,
  product_name,
  '$' || ROUND(standard_price, 2) AS std_price,
  total_units_sold AS units,
  '$' || ROUND(total_revenue, 2) AS revenue,
  '$' || ROUND(estimated_profit, 2) AS profit,
  profit_margin_pct || '%' AS margin,
  stores_reached AS stores,
  total_transactions AS transactions
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank
LIMIT 15
